biomarker_summary: Total Sleep Time. Total time actually asleep while in bed
Criteria_note: Based on recommended adult sleep duration
Visualization: Figure (including light exposure, easy for non-experts to interpret) plus TST, SL, SE etc. as a table/heatmap
Recommended_timing: After every sleep period; additional check the day before EVA and after schedule changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain median sleep time over ≥14 pre-flight days with the same device; compare the in-flight 7-day rolling median as difference (h) and % change.

biomarker_summary: Sleep Latency. Time from lying down to actually falling asleep
Criteria_note: >30 min = delayed sleep onset; 60 min cutoff is a design value
Visualization: Figure (including light exposure, easy for non-experts to interpret) plus TST, SL, SE etc. as a table/heatmap
Recommended_timing: After every sleep period; additional check the day before EVA and after schedule changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 14-day pre-flight median sleep latency; compare the in-flight 7-day median as difference (min) and check for sustained increase.

biomarker_summary: Sleep Efficiency. Actual sleep time (SLP) as a percentage of time in bed (TIB)
Criteria_note: <85% = reduced sleep efficiency; 75% cutoff is a design value
Visualization: Figure (including light exposure, easy for non-experts to interpret) plus TST, SL, SE etc. as a table/heatmap
Recommended_timing: After every sleep period; additional check the day before EVA and after schedule changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 14-day pre-flight mean sleep efficiency (%); compare the in-flight 7-day mean as percentage-point (p.p.) difference.

biomarker_summary: Wake After Sleep Onset. Total time awake between falling asleep and the final morning awakening
Criteria_note: >30 min = sleep maintenance problem; 60 min cutoff is a design value
Visualization: Figure (including light exposure, easy for non-experts to interpret) plus TST, SL, SE etc. as a table/heatmap
Recommended_timing: After every sleep period; additional check the day before EVA and after schedule changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 14-day pre-flight median WASO; compare the in-flight 7-day median as difference (min).

biomarker_summary: Time of falling asleep and time of final morning awakening
Criteria_normal: Mid-sleep time within ±60 min of individual baseline
Criteria_danger: >120 min shift or >60 min shift on 3 consecutive days
Criteria_note: Relative to pre-flight individual baseline; cutoffs are design values
Visualization: Figure (including light exposure, easy for non-experts to interpret) plus TST, SL, SE etc. as a table/heatmap
Recommended_timing: After every sleep period; additional check the day before EVA and after schedule changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 14-day pre-flight distribution of bedtime and wake time; compare in-flight timing deviation (min) and day-to-day variability (SD). Adjust for mission schedule/time zone.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Average blood glucose over the past 2–3 months; indicator for diabetes diagnosis and glycemic control
Criteria_note: ADA criteria; ≥6.5% requires confirmatory testing
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; 3 months after confirmed hyperglycemia or treatment change
earth_space_comparison: Compare pre-launch HbA1c (%) with in-/post-flight values in percentage points; allow ≥8–12 weeks between tests.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Protein released into the blood when heart muscle is damaged; indicator of myocardial infarction
Criteria_warning: Above URL, no change on serial measurement, asymptomatic
Criteria_danger: Above URL with significant rise/fall on serial measurement, or with symptoms/ECG abnormality
Criteria_note: Use assay-specific URL (e.g. hs-cTn); evaluate delta, symptoms and ECG together rather than a single value
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Immediately on chest pain, dyspnea or suspected cardiac event; repeat within hours if needed
earth_space_comparison: A routine individual baseline is not required; on symptoms, judge by the assay-specific 99th percentile URL and serial change. If a pre-launch value exists, compare only within the same assay.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Protein released into the blood when heart muscle is damaged; indicator of myocardial infarction
Criteria_warning: Above upper limit, up to 2× upper limit
Criteria_note: Example upper limit 5 ng/mL (assay-dependent); 2× cutoff is a design value
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Supplementary test when myocardial injury is suspected
earth_space_comparison: A routine pre-launch value is not required; on symptoms, interpret with the lab upper limit, change over time and troponin results.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Protein secreted by prostate cells; indicator for prostate cancer screening and diagnosis
Criteria_note: 4–10 is a gray zone; cannot diagnose cancer alone; age-specific reference ranges differ
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre-flight if needed; on urinary symptoms
earth_space_comparison: Obtain a pre-launch baseline only when medically indicated; compare pre/post-flight values and rate of change from the same assay in clinical context.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Tumor marker characteristically elevated in testicular or liver cancer
Criteria_note: Depends on lab and clinical context; cannot diagnose cancer alone
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: When clinically indicated for liver disease or tumor
earth_space_comparison: Not a routine space-environment comparison marker; when clinically indicated, compare the trend with prior values from the same assay.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Tumor marker mainly observed in colorectal, gastric and other cancers
Criteria_note: Non-smoker upper reference 3 ng/mL; varies with smoking and disease; unsuitable as a screening test
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: When indicated, e.g. follow-up of a known tumor
earth_space_comparison: Not a routine space-environment comparison marker; when clinically indicated, compare the trend with prior values from the same assay.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Lipid metabolism indicator predicting cardiovascular disease risk
Criteria_note: ≥160 risk enhancer, ≥190 evaluate for severe hypercholesterolemia; targets vary by individual risk
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; 4–12 weeks after a change in lipid therapy
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch LDL-C (mg/dL) with fasting status and assay recorded; compare in-/post-flight absolute difference and % change.

biomarker_summary: [Blood] Lipid metabolism indicator predicting cardiovascular disease risk
Criteria_note: ≥130 cardiovascular risk enhancer; targets vary by individual risk
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on lipid abnormality or treatment change
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch ApoB (mg/dL); compare in-/post-flight absolute difference and % change using the same assay.

biomarker_summary: [Urine] Proteinuria. Leakage of protein into urine; indicator of reduced kidney function and kidney disease
Criteria_note: KDIGO A1/A2/A3
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on suspected kidney disease, hypertension or diabetes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch urine albumin/creatinine ratio (UACR, mg/g); compare in-flight repeat tests by category (<30, 30–299, ≥300). Consider hydration and exercise effects.

biomarker_summary: [Urine] Glucose excreted in urine when blood glucose exceeds a threshold; indicator of suspected diabetes
Criteria_note: Detection limit varies by test strip; check blood glucose if positive
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: On suspected hyperglycemia or symptoms; pre/post flight
earth_space_comparison: A pre-launch negative result is not required; interpret in-flight positivity together with concurrent blood glucose/HbA1c.

biomarker_summary: [Urine] Blood in the urine; indicator of urinary tract abnormalities such as urothelial cancer, cystitis and kidney stones
Criteria_note: AUA microhematuria definition (≥3/HPF); on a properly collected specimen
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: On suspected hematuria, urinary symptoms or stones; pre/post flight
earth_space_comparison: A pre-launch negative result is not required; if positive in flight, repeat and confirm microscopic RBC/HPF, considering EVA, exercise and contamination.

biomarker_summary: [Blood+Urine] Kidney function indicator that evaluates glomerular filtration by comparing blood and urine
Criteria_warning: Rise ≥0.3 mg/dL within 48 h or 1.5–1.9× baseline within 7 d
Criteria_note: KDIGO AKI stage 1–3 criteria
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on suspected dehydration, worsening kidney function or drug effect
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 1–2 resting pre-launch serum creatinine (mg/dL) values and eGFR; compare in-flight absolute increase and % change. Consider muscle mass changes.

biomarker_summary: [Blood+Urine] Urea nitrogen. Kidney function indicator that evaluates glomerular filtration by comparing blood and urine
Criteria_note: Example adult reference range (varies by lab); 40 cutoff is a design value
Visualization: Show each value as a bar chart. See the 'biomarker summary visualization' figure for meaning
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on suspected dehydration or kidney abnormality
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch BUN (mg/dL); interpret in-flight difference and % change together with creatinine and hydration status.

biomarker_summary: Ultrasound measurement of carotid artery wall thickness in the neck to estimate plaque burden and diagnose progression of atherosclerosis
Criteria_note: Also refer to age/sex percentiles; no universal risk CIMT value
Visualization: Rated normal <0.9 mm / moderate 0.9–1.5 mm / high >1.5 mm
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight ultrasound; on suspected vascular disease
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch CIMT (mm) and plaque presence by ultrasound at the same site/protocol; compare the post-flight difference (mm) at the same site. Do not over-interpret short-term changes.

biomarker_summary: Quantitative status of basic blood cells: RBC, WBC (+differential), Hb, Hct, platelets, etc.
Criteria_note: Normal ranges vary by lab; warning/danger cutoffs are design values
Visualization: Show the 4 items as separate heatmaps, each rated normal / moderate / high
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on post-EVA symptoms, abnormal radiation exposure or suspected infection
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 1–2 pre-launch CBCs (RBC, WBC, Hb, Hct, platelets); compare in-flight absolute values and % change against lab reference. Consider fluid shifts.

biomarker_summary: Changes in immune cell composition (T cell, B cell, NK cell, monocyte, etc.) not visible from WBC count alone
Criteria_note: Only the CD4 threshold is established; no common risk value for T/B/NK overall → others use baseline ±1 SD / 1–2 SD / >2 SD
Visualization: Show the 4 items as separate heatmaps, each rated normal / moderate / high
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; on suspected infection/immune abnormality, or at the medical team's discretion after a high-exposure event
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch absolute counts and proportions of T/B/NK cells with the same flow cytometry panel; compare in-flight absolute change per cell type and proportion change (p.p.).

biomarker_summary: Immune cell activation and inflammatory status: IL-6, IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-10, IFN-γ, CRP, etc.
Criteria_note: Combines hs-CRP cardiovascular risk categories (<1/1–3/>3) with the acute inflammation threshold (>10); IL-6 etc. per assay
Visualization: Show the 4 items as separate heatmaps, each rated normal / moderate / high
Recommended_timing: On fever, suspected infection, post-EVA symptoms or abnormal radiation exposure
earth_space_comparison: Obtain resting pre-launch baselines for CRP, IL-6, etc.; compare in-flight fold change and duration using the same assay. Record infection and EVA effects.

biomarker_summary: Cellular and DNA damage from space radiation and oxidative stress: γ-H2AX, 53BP1, 8-OHdG, MDA, 8-isoprostane, etc.
Criteria_note: No standardized clinical risk values for γ-H2AX, 8-OHdG etc. → baseline-based design values
Visualization: Show the 4 items as separate heatmaps, each rated normal / moderate / high
Recommended_timing: Medical judgment after an abnormal radiation exposure event; pre/post flight
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch baselines for γ-H2AX/8-OHdG etc. with the same specimen type and assay; compare in-flight % or fold change against cumulative radiation dose and EVA timing. Not clinical risk values.

biomarker_summary: Sensorimotor speed and basic motor coordination
Criteria_normal: Accuracy and reaction time within ±1 SD of individual baseline
Criteria_note: No established absolute risk score → design values based on pre-flight repeated-measure distribution
Visualization: Bar chart
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight and monthly; as needed for cognitive abnormality, sleep loss or around EVA
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch baseline distribution of accuracy and reaction time after repeated practice on the same test version; compare in flight by z-score and confidence interval.

biomarker_summary: Behavioral alertness and sustained attention (vigilance) measured via reaction time
Criteria_normal: Lapses (>500 ms) <5; median reaction time within ±1 SD of baseline
Criteria_warning: Lapses 5–10 or reaction time increase of 1–2 SD
Criteria_danger: Lapses >10 or reaction time increase >2 SD
Criteria_note: No universal risk lapse count; cutoffs are design values
Visualization: Bar chart
Recommended_timing: Daily, or as a fatigue check before critical tasks/EVA; after sleep loss
earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch baseline distribution of median reaction time and lapse count at the same test length and time of day; compare with in-flight daily/7-day rolling values. Adjust for sleep and work hours.

biomarker_summary: Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes, Actinobacteria, Proteobacteria, etc. Assessment of digestive health, metabolic disorders, systemic inflammation and gut–brain axis interaction; colorectal disease screening
Criteria_normal: Shannon diversity decrease <10% vs baseline; Bray–Curtis distance <0.3
Criteria_note: No universal absolute risk value → baseline-based design values; check pathogen test results separately
Recommended_timing: Pre/post flight; after antibiotics, GI symptoms, infection or hygiene environment changes
earth_space_comparison: Obtain individual baseline distribution of composition and alpha diversity from ≥2 pre-launch stool samples; compare in-flight diversity change and Bray–Curtis distance with the same sequencing and analysis pipeline. Adjust for diet and antibiotics.

biomarker_summary: Bacteroidetes, Proteobacteria, Streptococcus, etc. Oral health diagnosis, respiratory disease risk assessment and discovery of non-invasive biomarkers

earth_space_comparison: Obtain baseline distribution from ≥2 pre-launch samples under the same collection time and oral hygiene conditions; compare in-flight diversity, relative abundance and community distance.

biomarker_summary: Cutibacterium, Corynebacterium, Staphylococcus, etc. Skin disease, wound healing and forensic identification

earth_space_comparison: Obtain baseline distribution from pre-launch samples at the same skin sites; compare in-flight diversity and community distance per site. Record sampling site, cleansers and environmental effects.

Criteria_note: 0–10 self-rating scale; unvalidated design values
Visualization: Compare with actigraphy measurements
Recommended_timing: Daily right after waking; sleep check the day before EVA
earth_space_comparison: Obtain 14 pre-launch days of daily scores on the same questionnaire scale; compare the in-flight 7-day mean as score difference. Cross-check with actigraphy.

earth_space_comparison: Obtain pre-launch visual dependence and related sensorimotor test scores; compare in-/post-flight change in error and reaction time under the same conditions.
